blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is seeking public feedback on two proposed measures that would raise the capital requirements for broker-dealers and tighten oversight of third-party collection agencies. The first draft circular, which is open for comments until Oct. 14, requires broker-dealers to maintain at least P120 million in unimpaired paid-up capital. READ: PSE reviving plan to increase capital requirement on brokers The requirement would cover exchange trading participants and non-exchange broker-dealers, including first-time registrants and companies acquiring existing broker-dealer businesses.
